name: general-marketplace
description: Two Claude Code plugins: precision-delivery (ship with accuracy and DORA-grade quality gates) and growth-engine (sales automation, marketing, and monetization with MCP connectors).

plugins.name: precision-delivery
plugins.description: Skills, commands, and agents for shipping software with extreme precision — PR-size enforcement, TDD, Definition of Done gates, feature-flag vs canary patterns, DORA metrics, developer toil elimination.

plugins.name: growth-engine
plugins.description: Skills, commands, agents, and MCP connectors for B2B sales automation (ICP, signal stacking, cadences), content marketing (AIDA/PAS, SEO clusters), and monetization (LTV:CAC, NRR, trial-to-paid).
